title: Aquazone: Desktop Life Option Disc Series 5: False Rummy-Nose

overview: Aquazone: Desktop Life Option Disc Series 5: False Rummy-Nose is a Sega Saturn simulation game released exclusively in Japan. It is not technically a game, but rather a tropical fish simulator.
